basis: Source-controlled static interface inspection and procedural 3D geometry smoke testing using a Three-compatible stand-in. No real GPU WebGL rendering.

checks.name: Viewer script syntax and DOM
checks.detail: v12 HTML module parses, IDs are unique, and all referenced UI IDs exist.

checks.name: Desktop geometry
checks.detail: 570 objects including 290 batched fasteners, 11 engineering parts and two track assemblies.

checks.name: Mobile geometry
checks.detail: 570 objects, 290 batched fasteners; desktop and mobile construction tests both complete.

checks.name: Suspension alternatives
checks.detail: Three modes: bare (no hypothetical rocker group visible), paired (two visible paired groups), independent (two visible independent groups).

checks.name: Suspension historical geometry
checks.detail: Balance arms existed, but actual rocker topology and joint geometry are unknown.

checks.name: Nominal blade-level proxy
checks.detail: 41 motion combinations produced finite values, relative margin -0.891 to 1.216 arbitrary scene units; 21 values indicate possible crossing of nominal lower crawler level.

checks.name: Real collision physics
checks.detail: No triangle-level intersection, self-contact, drive constraints, load/dynamics or verified physical geometry. Proxy cannot prove safe movement.

checks.name: WebGL visual render
checks.detail: Local Chromium WebGL init failed with EGL/ANGLE errors; real 3D appearance and overlay not browser-certified.

checks.name: Historical dimensional accuracy
checks.detail: No documented scale or calibrated photogrammetry; relative 3D scene ratios are internal.

blockers: Obtain authentic original front/side images showing balance-link pivot joints.
Acquire physical dimensions or manufacturer blueprints before accepting any geometry.
Use actual WebGL browser on user's device to validate rendering, raycasting, input and archive overlay.
Determine functional angle limits before labeling arbitrary slider bounds as real mechanical limits.
Verify whether model bucket tip and crawler profile intersect in more rigorous geometry check.
status: v12 implements a source-aware comparison of suspension hypotheses and warnings for a simulated bucket-blade proxy. Geometry smoke tests pass; historical accuracy remains unverified.
